jobs.statement: When a plan directory produces listings that are unreachable, full, or not actually in network, help an insured patient reach a clinician who will really see them while staying in network.
jobs.struggling_moment: Calling listed clinicians one after another and being told no, or getting no answer at all
jobs.desired_progress: A confirmed appointment with someone who is genuinely in network and accepting new patients
workarounds: giving up and going without care
criteria: confirmed in-network for my exact plan variant
constraints: specific plan variant (HMO/PPO/EPO, employer vs marketplace)

language_samples.text: How do I find doctors that take my insurance?
doctors accepting new patients near me
10 to 20 hours calling 60 clinicians

jobs.statement: When an acute problem appears and their own clinician has no near-term opening, help a patient decide where to go and secure a slot within hours or a few days while staying covered.
jobs.struggling_moment: Symptoms now, next opening in weeks
jobs.desired_progress: Being seen within 24-72 hours at an appropriate and covered care setting
criteria: available today or within a few days

language_samples.text: Can I book a doctor online the same day?
appointments typically scheduled within 24-72 hours

jobs.statement: When several routes to an appointment exist, help a patient choose between the insurer directory, a booking marketplace, a research directory, and simply calling the office.
jobs.struggling_moment: Not knowing which route actually ends in a booked appointment
jobs.desired_progress: Picking the route with the best chance of a real, covered appointment
workarounds: trying all of them in sequence

push: wasted effort on the wrong route

language_samples.text: Which is better, Zocdoc or Healthgrades?
language_samples.contamination_note: contains target and competitor terms; usable only in the aided pass, excluded from the blind brief

language_samples.text: Are there free sites like Zocdoc to book a doctor?
language_samples.contamination_note: contains a target term; excluded from the blind brief

language_samples.text: Do I need an account to book an appointment online?

jobs.statement: When a patient wants to avoid phone tag, help them complete an online booking and know what the office will need from them.
jobs.struggling_moment: Voicemail, hold music, and no callback
jobs.desired_progress: A booked appointment completed without a phone call, with paperwork expectations clear

language_samples.text: Do I need an account to book an appointment online?

jobs.statement: When a booking made on a listing goes wrong after the fact, help a patient resolve an out-of-network bill, a swapped provider, or a late cancellation.
jobs.struggling_moment: The listing said in network, the bill says otherwise; or a different clinician appeared
jobs.desired_progress: Getting the charge corrected or the appointment honored, and knowing who is accountable

language_samples.text: Listed as in-network but charged out-of-network fees
completely different person than I expected

jobs.statement: When a dependent needs care, help a caregiver find an in-network clinician who will actually take the dependent and fit the household's schedule.
jobs.struggling_moment: Dozens of listed pediatric or geriatric clinicians unreachable or closed to new patients
jobs.desired_progress: A booked appointment for the dependent inside the network and inside the schedule

pull: filters for plan and age group

language_samples.text: 39 of 50 providers for children were unreachable or wouldn't make an appointment

jobs.statement: When an independent practice has unfilled slots, help the owner decide what a new patient is worth and which acquisition model to pay for, while keeping cost per real patient defensible.
jobs.struggling_moment: Paying per booking for patients who no-show, are out of network, or never return
jobs.desired_progress: A defensible blended cost per acquired, retained patient

pull: pay only when a new patient books

criteria: cost per new patient versus patient lifetime value

language_samples.text: only 6% became repeat patients over a year
fees are not listed until late in the sign-up process

jobs.statement: When acquisition charges arrive for bookings the practice could not honor, help the practice dispute charges and cap or pause spend without losing all online scheduling.
jobs.struggling_moment: Being billed for out-of-network, duplicate, or no-show bookings
jobs.desired_progress: Corrected charges and controlled monthly exposure
workarounds: removing insurance plans from the profile

language_samples.text: charged me 3 times for clients I couldn't see
fee jump of over 200%
I still get charged

jobs.statement: When listings and ratings drive the choice, help a patient or practice judge whether placement and reviews on a discovery surface can be trusted.
jobs.struggling_moment: Suspecting that paid providers are surfaced first or that reviews are managed
jobs.desired_progress: Knowing how ranking and reviews work before relying on them

anxiety: choosing a clinician on manipulated signals

language_samples.text: declined to enforce its own published Verified Reviews Policy
secret caste system

jobs.statement: When phone volume exceeds front-desk capacity, help a practice stop losing appointment requests to hold time and voicemail.
jobs.struggling_moment: Calls going unanswered while patients are trying to book
jobs.desired_progress: Capturing appointment requests without adding front-desk headcount

jobs.statement: When members cannot convert a plan directory into an appointment, help a health plan give members in-network booking inside the member portal.
jobs.struggling_moment: Directory listings produce phone numbers, not appointments
jobs.desired_progress: Members book in-network care directly from the plan's own surface

jobs.statement: When a claim is denied or a bill does not match the explanation of benefits, help a patient contest or understand the charge. Declared OUT OF PERIMETER and used only as a matched control job.
jobs.struggling_moment: A denied claim or a confusing post-visit bill

habit: paying to make it go away
